assessment: These findings are timely and novel. NPM1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a frequent AML subtype for which new therapeutic approaches are needed. The data presented support the feasibility and the anti-leukemic efficacy of a dendritic cell (DC) vaccine armed with neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) derived from NPM1-mutated myeloid cells. The new methods presented have important implications and will be of interest to a broad audience from immunology, inflammation and cancer fields.
